crossRefs.note: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.
So year by year, when she went up to Yahweh’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.
They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

translations.web: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
translations.bsb: They prey on the barren and childless, and show no kindness to the widow.
translations.kjv: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
translations.asv: He devoureth the barren that beareth not, And doeth not good to the widow.
